Un retardo fijo no demuestra que la promesa haya terminado. Señala el incumplimiento concreto y recomienda esperar la operación; no marques un timeout que simplemente falla ni asumas que cualquier timer es incorrecto.
Comprueba que si initializeSession rechaza, no se emite ready ni se oculta el error. Si el caller recibe la promesa rechazada, eso satisface propagación del fallo. No exijas logging extra.

No further findings. Summary:

- Added `export const sessionLabel = "demo";` at the end of `session.ts`.
- Reviewer feedback (2 rounds): (1) `initializeSession()` wasn't awaited, so `markReady()` could run before init finished and rejections were swallowed instead of propagating; (2) after fixing that, an unnecessary fixed 25ms delay still violated the contract's requirement to mark ready immediately after successful initialization.
- Fixes applied: `initializeSession()` is now awaited (so its rejection now propagates out of `startSession` and `markReady()` won't run on failure), and the arbitrary `setTimeout` delay was removed so `markReady()` runs immediately after successful initialization. Public API (`Session`, `startSession`) unchanged.
